entities.name: Query protein (368 aa)
observations: The 368-aa sequence is an exact full-length sequence match to reviewed UniProt protein C2K1F0 from Lacticaseibacillus rhamnosus.
Belongs to the FMN hydroxy-acid dehydrogenase family; Pfam FMN_dh spans residues 28-363.
Sequence-derived molecular mass is approximately 38.8 kDa and theoretical pI is 5.93.

entities.name: C2K1F0 L-lactate oxidase
observations: Reviewed UniProt annotation identifies this enzyme as L-lactate oxidase.
Binds one FMN cofactor per subunit and is annotated as a homotetramer.
Catalyzes oxidation of (S)-lactate to pyruvate with reduction of O2 to H2O2.
The reference protein is 100% identical over 100% of the query and target sequences.

entities.name: L-lactate oxidation
observations: Reaction: (S)-lactate + O2 -> pyruvate + H2O2; mapped to Rhea RHEA:55868.
The enzyme may also oxidize 2-hydroxyoctanoate and other 2-hydroxyacids, but exact substrate breadth is not established from sequence alone.

entities.name: FMN cofactor
observations: The protein binds one FMN molecule per subunit; GO annotation includes FMN binding (GO:0010181).
